name: ryomc-image
description: Generate and edit images through a user's Ryomc New API key in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Generate or edit images in Codex via Ryomc.
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex to generate an image or edit a local image through your own Ryomc API key. Requires one-time local setup; keys are never included in the plugin.
defaultPrompt: 用 Ryomc Image 生成一张插画：雨夜中的咖啡店。
用 Ryomc Image 把我附上的图片改成水彩风格。
